## How to Add Videos to Multi-Photo Post Types


Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000077558

It is now possible to add videos to multi-photo albums like classifieds, products, etc. Follow these steps to learn how!

Navigate to Content » Edit Post Settings and look for the multi-photo post type to enable this feature and click on " Edit ":

On the General Settings tab, scroll down and click on "Additional Settings". Look for the Enable Photo Gallery Videos option and select "Yes":

Once the feature has been enabled, members will be able to add videos to the uploaded pictures by entering a Youtube or Vimeo link:

*Do not forget to save the changes.
